method: Piecewise annual history combining pre-1955 federation/ITF lineage with current national membership, club, league, tournament, coaching and international-event pathway evidence.
evidence_rules: Current membership/club/team/coach counts are used only from 2026 and are not backcast.
2025 ITF World Tennis Tour hosting informs competition and professional-transition opportunity from 2025 onward.
Major ATP/Challenger hosting informs 2026 competition quality but is not treated as domestic player quality.
Historical federation and ITF-founder facts primarily anchor tradition/institutional continuity.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
